Definition: Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Chepher is both a place and a man's name, and the two uses sit side by side in the record. Joshua lists a king of Hepher among the kings he struck down, Solomon's officer Ben-hesed governs the land of Hepher, and a man named Hepher appears in the families of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name reminds me that places and people share one story in Scripture, and that God works through towns and families alike.
